You're standing with a group of classmates. When you begin to talk, no one looks at you. Why isn't anyone looking at you? 
 
They just happen to be looking at something else, but they are interested in what I have to say. . 

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 1::1: Doesn't pop up in my mind
3::3: Might pop up in my mind
5::5: Definitely pops up in my mind
